baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated divine root in 'Allah ... no deity except Him'.
baseline_models.mechanism: The positive identification and enclosed negation remove rival objects of worship, turning the sentence from a naming equation into an exclusive orientation of devotion.

activation_trace.role: The worship-and-worshipped sense makes the doubled root carry exclusive devotional orientation.

changed_reading.before: The opening merely identifies God and denies another deity.
changed_reading.after: The opening establishes a sole center of worship and allegiance, with every later attribute describing that exclusive center.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: 'Knower of the unseen and the witnessed'.
baseline_models.mechanism: The governing knowledge term spans what is screened from creatures and what is present to observation; the witness root also permits knowledgeable declaration, so the pair can move from concealment through presence into disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as the thing becoming uncovered supplies the encompassing epistemic action.
Screening from eyes supplies the concealed pole that remains open to the Knower.
Presence with direct observation supplies the manifest pole of the pair.
Knowledge-bearing testimony lets the manifest pole function as disclosure and evidence, not visibility alone.

changed_reading.before: The phrase lists two static classes of facts known by God.
changed_reading.after: Divine knowledge crosses the creaturely boundary between concealed and present and can make what is known stand forth as disclosed evidence.

baseline_models.mechanism: Two adjacent formations from the mercy root close the verse, placing tenderness and benefaction as the horizon within which exclusive deity and exhaustive knowledge are received.

activation_trace.role: Tenderness, compassion, and benefaction make mercy an active relation to the known creature.

changed_reading.before: The final two names are a reassuring pair appended to knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Mercy is the verse's governing closure: the One who knows all hidden and visible reality relates to it through active compassion and benefaction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human conjecture treats an enclosing fortification as sufficient protection, but a force cast into hearts becomes visible as the inhabitants' destruction of their own buildings. The unseen-witnessed pair therefore operates as a causal transit from inaccessible interior to public material result.

activation_trace.role: Uncovering knowledge anchors the reading in the focus ayah's divine epistemic claim.
What is screened from creaturely sight supplies the inward side of the causal passage.
Observable presence supplies the outward result in which the hidden disturbance becomes legible.
Uncertain imagining supplies the failed human knowledge model that the focus claim overturns.
Protection inside an enclosing fort supplies the visible shell mistaken for causal security.
Casting something across a distance supplies the directional entry of fear into the interior.
The heart supplies the concealed human site where the reversal begins.
Ruined habitation supplies the publicly witnessed endpoint of the inward change.

structural_cues: 59:2 opens with the same 'He is the one who' construction used by the focus ayah.
The sequence moves from what both sides expected, through an uncalculated avenue and fear in hearts, to houses destroyed by their owners' hands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed expectation, enclosure, inward fear, and outward self-demolition; I map that stated sequence onto the focus pair as hidden-to-visible causation. A live alternative treats 59:2 only as military causation and the focus pair as a general knowledge formula.

changed_reading.before: God knows both hidden and visible facts.
changed_reading.after: God knows and governs the passage by which an unseen interior alteration defeats visible defenses and produces a witnessed historical outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context blocks wealth from closing around the rich, praises choosing others over the self despite need, names resistance to possessive withholding as success, and calls earlier believers brothers. Mercy thus acquires a communal mechanism: outward circulation that defeats enclosure and makes relation.

activation_trace.role: Compassion expressed as benefaction anchors material and affective giving in the focus names.
Near kinship supplies a relational model that the context extends beyond blood.
Movement among hands supplies the distributive mechanism and its warning against a closed circuit.
Choosing another over oneself supplies the outward direction of merciful transfer.
Eager withholding supplies the inward blockage that communal mercy must overcome.
Brotherhood and relation supply the social bond created across generations of believers.

structural_cues: 59:7 turns recovered property into a named beneficiary network rather than a rich-only circuit.
59:9 moves from love of migrants to preference over self, while 59:10 extends relation to believers who came earlier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies circulation, other-preference, resistance to withholding, and brotherhood; I read these as a social enactment of the focus root's compassion and kinship branches. A live alternative keeps the legal and ethical sequence adjacent to, but not explanatory of, the divine names.

changed_reading.before: Al-Rahman and al-Rahim indicate generous feeling or favor.
changed_reading.after: The names also govern an anti-hoarding economy of mercy in which goods, preference, and belonging move outward to make a community of kin.

context_deltas.mechanism: God's witness exposes a spoken promise as false, while human estimation reads a group as united although its hearts are dispersed. Divine knowledge of unseen and witnessed becomes forensic knowledge of the mismatch between public declaration or appearance and concealed interior reality.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure anchors the capacity to expose a mismatch.
Concealment supplies the inaccessible intention and divided interior.
Knowledge-bearing testimony makes divine knowing capable of a public verdict.
The contextual act of informed witness supplies the explicit forensic operation.
Contradiction of truth supplies the verdict on the outward promise.
Estimation supplies the fallible observer's reading of visible unity.
Hearts supply the concealed level that contradicts collective appearance.
Dispersion supplies the hidden plurality beneath an apparently gathered body.

structural_cues: 59:11 places a confident public pledge beside God's immediate witness that its speakers lie.
59:14 directly opposes 'you estimate them together' to 'their hearts are dispersed'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies divine witness, false speech, estimated unity, and divided hearts; I identify these as operational instances of the focus dyad and allow 'witnessed' to carry attestation as well as visibility. A live alternative reads unseen and witnessed as ontological domains without this forensic specialization.

changed_reading.before: The knowledge formula expresses comprehensive awareness.
changed_reading.after: The formula authorizes a forensic disclosure that tests public speech and visible cohesion against intentions and hearts unavailable to human observers.

context_deltas.mechanism: A self is ordered to inspect what it has sent forward for tomorrow, and divine interior knowledge is tied to intentional action. The focus pair becomes temporally dynamic: witnessed work advances toward a future presently unseen but already open to divine knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Uncovering knowledge anchors God's complete grasp of the act and its destination.
Creaturely concealment supplies tomorrow as a horizon not yet visible.
Present observable action supplies the witnessed starting point of the temporal passage.
Directing sight or insight supplies deliberate self-examination at the present moment.
Advancing something forward supplies the deed's movement beyond its present performance.
The following day supplies the near lexical model for an unseen future of consequence.
Knowledge of reports and inward reality sharpens the focus claim toward motive and consequence.
Intentional action supplies the accountable material that crosses from today into tomorrow.

structural_cues: 59:18 encloses self-inspection between two commands to be wary of God.
The verse links what a self sends ahead to God's inwardly informed knowledge of what people do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inspection, forward sending, tomorrow, inward knowledge, and deeds; I map their temporal vector onto witnessed present and unseen consequence. A live alternative restricts 'tomorrow' to eschatological warning without making it a model for the focus pair.

changed_reading.before: Unseen and witnessed are simultaneous regions within divine awareness.
changed_reading.after: They are also moments in moral time: a visible intentional deed is sent into an unseen tomorrow whose reality and inward motive are already known.

context_deltas.mechanism: Forgetting Allah is followed causatively by forgetting one's own self. Against that collapse, the focus ayah's repeated 'He ... Him ... He' and exclusive divine naming can function as counter-memory: correct orientation toward God stabilizes rather than erases self-recognition.

activation_trace.role: Exclusive worship supplies the orienting relation restored by the focus formula.
Loss of remembrance supplies both the initial divine forgetting and its causative echo in self-forgetting.
The thing's own self or identity supplies what becomes inaccessible when orientation is lost.

structural_cues: 59:19 gives forgetting a mirrored construction: they forgot Allah, so He caused them to forget themselves.
59:22 repeatedly reasserts the divine subject before naming knowledge and mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the causal forgetting of self after forgetting Allah; I infer that reciting the focus identification can work as its rhetorical reversal. A live alternative treats the focus opening only as doctrinal identification, not a mnemonic practice.

changed_reading.after: The formula can also be heard as a recovery of orientation whose remembrance prevents the self from becoming lost to itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: A high solid mass is imagined lowered and fissured by revealed address under awe, and the focus naming follows immediately. The names therefore read not as inert metadata but as disclosure meant to penetrate hardness, produce humility, and set thought in motion.

activation_trace.role: Exclusive deity supplies the content toward which the preceding revealed address reorients its hearer.
Disclosure to the Knower supplies a name whose content exposes the hearer rather than merely informing.
Compassion and benefaction make the transformative address restorative as well as overwhelming.
An elevated solid mass supplies the maximal image of resistant receptivity.
Lowering and submission supply the first transformation of what was elevated and hard.
A fissure opening in solid material supplies the visible effect of penetrative disclosure.
Fear joined to awe supplies the affective pressure mediating disclosure and transformation.
The heart's repeated turning over a matter supplies the intended human continuation of the mountain image.

structural_cues: 59:21 ends by directing the images toward human reflection, and 59:22 immediately begins the repeated divine naming.
The movement from a hypothetical recipient of revelation to the identity and names of its speaker gives adjacency a performative force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revelation, solid elevation, lowering, fissure, awe, reflection, and immediate divine naming; I infer that the names participate in the address whose effect was just modeled. A live alternative takes 59:21 as a statement about the whole Quran without special reference to the adjacent names.

changed_reading.before: 59:22 begins a list of divine attributes after an unrelated parable.
changed_reading.after: 59:22 is itself a concentrated revelatory address whose knowing and merciful content is meant to lower hardness, open fissures, and activate reflection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next naming sequence combines safety, witnessing care, and a root that holds both repair of breakage and coercive force. Because knowledge and mercy arrive first, mercy can frame the ensuing sovereignty as protective oversight and restoration while leaving coercion as a real unresolved edge.

activation_trace.role: Uncovering knowledge supplies the informed basis for the oversight named next.
Compassion and benefaction supply the proposed frame for the following powers.
Safety and freedom from harm supply the protective end toward which power may be ordered.
Witnessing joined to care supplies an oversight mode linking the focus knowledge to protection.
Repairing fracture and deficiency supplies the restorative possibility within compelling power.
Compulsion and overpowering preserve the harder possibility that prevents reducing sovereignty to comfort.

structural_cues: 59:23 repeats the full exclusive opening of 59:22, making its names a direct continuation rather than a detached list.
Mercy closes 59:22 immediately before safety, oversight, might, repair or compulsion, and greatness unfold in 59:23.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence and the care, safety, repair, and coercion branches; I infer that earlier mercy can interpret later power without canceling its hard edge. A live alternative treats all names as coordinate, so their order need not establish an interpretive hierarchy.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is one attribute pair alongside a later list of power names.
changed_reading.after: Mercy becomes the first lens on divine power: knowing oversight tends toward safety and repair, yet the coercive branch remains a contained tension rather than disappearing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following sequence moves through measure, bringing into existence, and formed appearance. Read back into the focus pair, the unseen and witnessed become stages of creative intelligibility: latent specification is fully known before and as it arrives in manifest form.

activation_trace.role: Uncovering knowledge anchors continuity across latent measure and realized form.
Concealment supplies the not-yet-manifest side of the creative analogy.
Presence to observation supplies realized form as the witnessed side.
Estimating and measuring supply a latent specification prior to visible realization.
Bringing a creation into being supplies the transition from specification to existence.
Given shape and appearance supply the observable endpoint of creative realization.

structural_cues: 59:24 begins with the same 'He is Allah' identification and immediately sequences Creator, Originator, and Former.
The focus knowledge pair directly precedes names whose branch images move from measure to existence to appearance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, creation, and formed appearance in sequence; I supply the directional analogy from latent specification to manifestation and align it with unseen and witnessed. A live alternative treats these as coequal titles and does not equate the unseen with potential or plan.

changed_reading.before: God knows realities whether hidden or visible.
changed_reading.after: Divine knowledge also spans the creative passage from hidden measure through origination into the form that becomes present to sight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the anatomical womb branch beneath divine mercy language; it remains anchored in the focus mercy root and the following creation-and-form sequence. Render it only as a gestational analogy for protected emergence, never as a replacement lexical gloss for al-Rahman or al-Rahim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled mercy root at 59:22:12-13, beside the concealed-witnessed pair.

activation_trace.role: The womb as a protected place of growth supplies a material analogy for mercy's containing action.
Concealment supplies the unseen phase of life held within the gestational analogy.
Presence to observation supplies emergence into the witnessed phase.
Creative bringing-into-being supplies the process sheltered by the analogy.
Formation into a visible shape supplies the analogy's endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is affective kindness toward already manifest creatures.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, mercy can be imagined as generative containment that knows and protects what is still hidden while bringing it toward formed, witnessed life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain ecological activation, not a claim that unseen and witnessed literally mean plant roots and signs. It remains valid as an inspectable analogy because all three images belong to focus-root inventories and the context supplies a palm standing on its base; downstream prose should label it as exploratory epistemic imagery.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The linked focus terms for knowing, unseen concealment, and witnessed presence.

activation_trace.role: A tree's roots hidden underground supply an ecological image for support outside ordinary sight.
A distinguishing mark supplies the visible trace by which a condition becomes legible.
A sign that bears witness supplies the above-ground indicator of hidden support.
The palm branch identifies the living material in which hidden support and visible standing meet.
Base and foundation supply the contextual support on which the visible tree remains standing.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge covers two abstract domains, hidden and visible.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, divine knowing resembles an epistemic ecology that holds concealed root-support together with the visible marks that testify to it.

strongest_changes: The unseen-witnessed pair became an inner-to-outer causal and forensic mechanism rather than a static totality.
Mercy became a communal practice of circulation, other-preference, and kin-making, then a possible frame for later power.
Present deeds were read as moving into an unseen tomorrow already open to divine knowledge.
The adjacent mountain and creation sequences made the names transformative address and a movement from latent measure to manifest form.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah's compact sequence of exclusive deity, exhaustive knowledge, and doubled mercy repeatedly activated against the surah's mismatches between appearance and interior, its anti-hoarding social relations, and its closing movement from revelatory impact to power and creation.
remaining_uncertainties: The order of the closing names may support mutual interpretation, but it may also be simple accumulation without hierarchy.
Interior versus exterior and latent measure versus formed appearance extend the primary unseen-witnessed contrast by analogy.
Gestational mercy and hidden-root ecology are deliberately branch-distant images and should remain qualified rather than lexicalized.
